div.head: Af 42.6
div.ab: Æfter ðære ilcan wisan mon mot feohtan mid his geborenum mæge, gif him mon on wóh onfeohteð, buton wið his hlaforde: ðæt we ne lyfað.
Æfter þære ilcan wisan mon mot feohtan mid his geborene mæge, gif hine mon on woh onfeohteð, buton wið his hlaforde: þæt we ne liefað.
Ad eundem modum potest homo pugnare cum germano cognato suo, si quis assalliat eum iniuste, preter contra dominum: hoc non concedimus.
Æfter þære ilcan wisan mon mot feohtan mid his geborene mæge, gif hine mon on woh onfeohteð, buton wið his hlaforde: þæt we ne liefeð.
In the same manner a man may fight at the side of his born kin, if they are attacked wrongfully, except against his lord: that we do not allow.
In the same way a man may fight on behalf of one who is related to him by blood, if he is attacked unjustly, except it be against his lord. This we do not permit.
In the same way, a man may fight on behalf of his born kinsman, if he is being wrongfully attacked, except against his lord; that we do not allow.
Nach derselben Weise darf man bei seinem angeborenen Verwandten fechten, wenn jemand diesen unrecht angreift; ausgenommen gegen den eigenen Herrn: letzteres erlauben wir nicht.
In the same way one may fight on behalf of one’s kinsman by birth, if someone attacks him wrongfully; except against one’s own lord: that we do not permit.
